definitions.explanation: Describes a person who tends to argue using logic and reasoning in an excessive or annoying way. Carries a negative connotation — implying the person is difficult to deal with because they always insist on logical explanations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{理屈|りくつ}っぽい⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{話|はなし}しにくい。
examples.english: He's so argumentative that he's hard to talk to.

examples.japanese: ⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧{理屈|りくつ}っぽいこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}わないで→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Don't be so pedantic about it.

examples.japanese: {理屈|りくつ}っぽい⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think my argumentative personality is why I don't have many friends.

notes:
FORMS:
Uses the ～⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧ suffix meaning "tending toward" or "-ish": ⟦{怒|おこ}りっぽい→怒りっぽい：30581_okorippoi⟧ (short-tempered), ⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧ (forgetful), ⟦{飽|あ}きっぽい→飽きっぽい：20351_akippoi⟧ (easily bored). The suffix generally carries a mildly negative nuance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理屈|りくつ}っぽい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a pedantic person)
- {理屈|りくつ}っぽい⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (an argumentative personality)
- {理屈|りくつ}っぽいこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say pedantic things)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{屁理屈|へりくつ}→屁理屈：15530_herikutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to make specious arguments — more negative, implies bad-faith reasoning
- ⟦くどい→くどい：10318_kudoi⟧: long-winded — focuses on repetitive explanation rather than logic
- ⟦{論理的|ろんりてき}→論理的：05672_ronriteki⟧: logical — neutral/positive, unlike {理屈|りくつ}っぽい which is negative
